name: The Black Anchor - Back Booths
description:
Low wooden booths line the walls of this dim back room, each half-hidden behind hanging canvas and old sailcloth. The air here is quieter, heavier with intent.

Conversations are kept low and deliberate. You catch fragments — lost routes, ruined places, opportunities that never make it to the guild board. Eyes linger longer here, measuring who might be listening.

The warmth of the common room fades behind you.
ambient_lines: A low conversation in the far booth stops, then resumes in quieter tones.
Canvas sways as someone shifts in the shadows.
The scrape of a chair; someone stands and moves toward the alcove.
You catch a fragment: "…never made it past the reef."
enter_flavor: A hooded patron falls silent mid-sentence when you get too close.
Eyes turn your way, then drift back to private business.
